notes: IVA general rate 15% (Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas fiscal report, Jan 2026, citing SRI Circular NAC-DGECCGC25-00000006 of 26 Dec 2025). The complete LRTI art. 55 zero-rate list was read: its only gold item (num. 16) zero-rates gold acquired by the Banco Central del Ecuador or by mining-concession/licensed traders - retail bullion takes 15%; silver is never mentioned in the law. Duty null.

sources.name: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (finanzas.gob.ec) - Informe de Seguimiento al Plan de Fortalecimiento y Sostenibilidad Fiscal, Jan 2026
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: per the SRI circular of 26 Dec 2025 the general IVA rate in force continues to be 15%
sources.quote: En consecuencia, la tarifa general del IVA vigente es del 15%, hasta que el Presidente de la República disponga lo contrario.

sources.name: Ley de Régimen Tributario Interno (SRI text), art. 55 numeral 16
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the art. 55 zero-rate list (numerals 1-17 read in full) zero-rates only gold acquired by the Banco Central or by concession holders/licensed traders
sources.quote: El oro adquirido por el Banco Central del Ecuador en forma directa o por intermedio de agentes económicos públicos o privados, debidamente autorizados por el propio Banco.
